insurer_error.description: Charges outside the admission under review

letter_deductions.deduction: Charges outside the admission under review
letter_deductions.why: The consolidated statement includes admissions A1 and A2. The submitted claim covers A1 only. A2 has its own admission ID and appears on the statement for reconciliation; it has not been submitted under A1. The insurer included both episodes in the A1 settlement. Review A1 only.
